research_notes: First-quarter report cards and parent conferences cluster in November, with sign-ups opening early in the month (e.g., HCPSS: conference sign-up opens Nov 4, conferences before Thanksgiving) - https://rhhs.hcpss.org/node/964 ; https://wilson.isd761.org/families/conferences ; https://winfieldes.bcps.org/parents/conferences

Marking-period calendars for 2026-27 place Q1 close in late Oct to early Nov - https://files-backend.assets.thrillshare.com/documents/asset/uploaded_file/3987/Vps/30deb5fc-fe3a-4194-9da0-efd52948b274/Important-Marking-Periods-Dates-2026_2027.pdf

DIBELS 8 benchmarks run BOY, MOY, EOY; MOY windows usually Dec-Jan, so reading-data pins go out 4-8 weeks ahead - https://dibels.uoregon.edu/sites/default/files/2026-06/dibels_benchmark_administration_timeline.pdf

Pinterest Predicts 2026 report has no school-specific trend we could verify; using the seasonal map (Oct-Nov: boards 8, 5, 7, 4) - https://www.socialmediatoday.com/news/pinterest-publishes-2026-trend-predictions-report/807452/
